incidentRules.titlePattern: Platform-owner session could not resolve a unique tenant|Guest storefront tenant resolver returned null

incidentRules.titlePattern: Acceptance coupon fixture was missing and failed coupon quote erased the last valid total

incidentRules.titlePattern: Stale Storefront Wave 76 branch was unsafe as a production release tree|Concurrent main advancement requires controlled reconciliation|Release-base proof must finish before merge

incidentRules.titlePattern: Special Commerce anti-fake boundaries
incidentRules.reason: Presentation/guidance may not invent server-owned commerce truth.

incidentRules.titlePattern: Accepted golden drift needs a non-circular promotion path
incidentRules.reason: Baseline promotion depended circularly on the baseline already being accepted.

incidentRules.titlePattern: Public storefront routes are not template visual-acceptance authority
incidentRules.reason: Real route presentation authority differed from the candidate template acceptance authority.

incidentRules.titlePattern: Surface Reduction / Dead Code audit after Market Ready
incidentRules.reason: Retained product/engineering lesson, not a historical failure class.

incidentRules.titlePattern: Marker-based schema proof can be false green

incidentRules.titlePattern: Short intent token caused scope explosion
